verdict.rationale: Codegen's SDK/API use a single org-level token (org_id + token) and org-wide permission toggles (e.g., allow/deny PR creation, require signed commits), but there is no documented mechanism to issue scoped, least-privilege API credentials per agent, task, or repo. missing for 10: scoped/short-lived API keys, per-agent credential minting, granular read/write permission tiers.
